# B2 vocabulary batch 89

## Scope

Added 25 manually authored B2 entries: `ghetto`, `giveaway`, `glamorous`, `glare`, `glee`, `globally`, `glocal`, `gloomy`, `glorify`, `glow`, `godly`, `goodwill`, `gorge`, `governmental`, `gracefulness`, `gradual`, `graphically`, `gravestone`, `greatness`, `grieve`, `grown-up`, `guerrilla`, `gulp`, `gunshot`, and `guts`.

Each entry was manually reviewed for meaning, part of speech, Vietnamese gloss, example pair, IPA, level, and controlled topic assignment. Obsolete or offensive source candidates were not added as lessons.
